summary: An appointee gives up a board seat to enter a legislative primary.
realLife: Harvey Milk left San Francisco’s permit appeals board when he announced his candidacy for the California Assembly, months after Mayor George Moscone appointed him.
inGame: needs: the terms of a board appointment linked to entry in a primary.

turns.what: The appointee turns down a run to finish the board's appeal calendar.
turns.pulledBy: The appointment would end on filing and appeals are pending.
turns.writesBack: The appointee keeps the seat through the appeals.

turns.what: The appointee files after the board enters its last decision of the term.
turns.pulledBy: The filing window extends beyond the term.
turns.writesBack: The board records a completed term.
